signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Enter your email and password to continue.
signIn.notVerified: Your email is not verified yet. We sent you a new code.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.description: An individual account to train on the protocols. You can join an institution later through an invitation.

verifyEmail.title: Verify your email
verifyEmail.description: We sent a 6-digit code to <addr>{email}</addr>. Enter it here to activate your account.
verifyEmail.descriptionNoEmail: Enter your email and the 6-digit code we sent you.
verifyEmail.success: Your email is verified. Welcome to Waqaya!

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email and we will send you a 6-digit code to reset your password.
forgotPassword.sent: If this email is registered, a code will arrive within a few minutes.

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.description: Enter the code we sent to <addr>{email}</addr> and a new password.
resetPassword.descriptionNoEmail: Enter your email, the code you received and a new password.
resetPassword.success: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password.

changePassword.title: Set a new password
changePassword.description: Replace your current password with a new one of your own.
changePassword.required: You must set a new password before using the platform.

errors.generic: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.emailOff: Email is turned off on this server, so the code cannot be sent.
errors.invalidCode: The code is incorrect or has expired.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Deletes your account and your personal data for good. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.removed: Your profile, your simulation attempts and results, your sign-in sessions, and your institution and department memberships.
deleteAccount.kept: Institutions keep, without your name: the scans you performed or finalised, the audit log and the AI usage log. Invitations you sent that are still pending move to another owner or admin of the institution; they are cancelled when there is none, or when you no longer belong to the institution.
deleteAccount.codeSent: We sent a 6-digit code to <addr>{email}</addr>. It expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
deleteAccount.passwordHint: Enter your current password to confirm it's you.
deleteAccount.understand: I understand that deleting the account is final and cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.codeResent: We sent you a new code. The earlier code no longer works.

errors.generic: We couldn't delete the account. Please try again shortly.
errors.impersonating: You cannot delete the account while you are acting as another user.
errors.blocked: This account cannot be deleted yet.
errors.blockedOwner: You are the only owner of an institution that has other members: {organizations}. Make another member an owner first, or ask the platform team to delete the institution.
errors.blockedLastAdmin: You are the last platform admin. Make another user an admin before you delete your account.
errors.emailOff: Email is turned off on this server, so the confirmation code cannot be sent.
errors.emailFailed: We couldn't send the confirmation code. Please try again shortly.
errors.tooManyRequests: You asked for too many codes. Try again in an hour.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait 15 minutes, then try again.
errors.expired: The code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.tooManyTries: Too many wrong tries. Ask for a new code.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign out, sign in again and try once more.

accountDeleted.title: Your account was deleted
accountDeleted.description: We deleted your account and your personal data. Institutions keep their records without your name. Thank you for using Waqaya.
